items.sentence: The farmer's morning routine started with feeding two brown cows.
Numerous clay jars filled the storage room behind the kitchen.
This legend about a stone turtle appears in two old books.
The museum shows military uniforms worn hundreds of years ago.
One old wooden weapon rests inside the museum's glass case.
Neighbors celebrate the harvest with rice cakes and folk songs.
History books describe one famous combat between two old kingdoms.
The historical setting shows why the family moved to the port.
Visitors walk through the royal garden behind the old palace.
A loyal dog waited beside the gate for many years.
